junction.name: Halladay Street & Birch Avenue North, Seattle

claims.text: Halladay Street & Birch Avenue North had 0 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 0 people killed.
These counts are Halladay Street & Birch Avenue North's own: the city's record places 87 of the 87 records within 100 m at another intersection or street, and they are left out.
No crash pattern here stands out against the city's worst crash locations (too few crashes to test).

The city's Leading Pedestrian Interval signals: passed the causal gate (pedestrian injury crashes changed -33% (95% interval -52% to -13%) at 371 sites against sites treated later or the citywide trend, and a placebo date shows nothing); a second run of the same design on 366 sites agrees.
The Seattle Department of Transportation (SDOT) is responsible for 5th Avenue North, 6th Avenue North, Birch Avenue North, Halladay Street (no route reference, so presumed a city street).
The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) (route designation only; confirm ownership) is responsible for Aurora Avenue North (signed route in OpenStreetMap; owner not confirmed).

A request letter to the Seattle Department of Transportation (SDOT) and the Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) (route designation only; confirm ownership) is ready to draft from these facts.
